expected_facts: The answer should connect audience growth to consistency, compounding content, or knowing what the audience repeatedly wants.
It should not just celebrate the milestone; it should explain the operating lesson behind it.
It should make content/community growth relevant to B2B founders.
rubric_must_haves: Turns the milestone into a founder lesson.
Includes at least one example of compounding distribution or content repetition.
Avoids sounding like a vanity-metrics post.
trace.gold_reference: A strong answer says the real lesson behind five million views is not virality but compounding consistency. Founders learn what their audience values, keep shipping, and let repeated useful content build trust and distribution over time. The piece should make the case that community and media scale the same way product and GTM do: through repetition, iteration, and audience fit.

retrieval_hits.text:
So we’ve finally crossed 50,000 subs on SaaStr YouTube.  It took a while, but I’m probably on the unparalled quality of our content, especially the past 18+ months or so where we stepped up the editing and more.
So if you want to catch up, here are The Top 10 Most Popular SaaStr YouTube Sessions of All Time.  Note I did take out a few that would have made the list but were a bit dated etc:
#1,  279,000 Views: “How To Perfectly Pitch Your Seed Stage Startup With Y Combinator’s Michael Seibel:
Ycombinator is pretty popular
#2.  112,000 Views: “What’s New at WordPress with Matt Mullenweg, CEO of Automattic and Co-Founder of WordPress”
#3, 79,000 Views: “A Step by Step Guide to Revenue Growth with Mark Roberge, Harvard Business School”
#4.  62,526 Views: “From 2 Weeks of Runway to $1B Acquisition: The Founder Playbook with Loom’s CEO and Co-Founder”
#5.  46,771 Views: “From Burn-Out to $100M in ARR with Jason Cohen, Founder of WP Engine”
#6.  41,000 Views:  “Veeva: The Biggest Vertical SaaS Success Story of All Time” with Founder/CEO Peter Gassner
#7,  37,000 Views: “Sales Mistakes that Can Kill Your SaaS Business & How to Avoid Them”
#8.  36,000 Views:  “Twilio: The Inside Story with Jeff Lawson, CEO/Co-Founder”
#9.  35,266 Views: “The Secrets to YC’s Essential Startup Advice with Y Combinator with Michael Seibel”
#10.  33,270 Views: “How To Innovate Faster with Community: Insights From GitLab CEO Sid Sijbrandij”
